method.population: Every code suffix .mjs/.js/.cjs/.py/.ts/.sh/.yml/.yaml changed or added from d8ab to committed HEAD anywhere in repository, union current V3 updates/additional code inputs. Working tree had no uncommitted code change.
method.packet_population: All physical compatibility/rc JSON text containing any exact changed source path, intersect immutable d8ab tree, plus explicitly new active base-class owner packet. All matching immutable packet whole bytes equal committed d8ab blob authenticated one Git batch. All original JSON files unchanged at HEAD; current additions do not replace old rows.
method.references: Recursively collect exact path+SHA256 (+size when present), carrying parent path for nested before/after records. Does not treat record presence as executable authority. Direct literal code routes and active member loops inspected separately.
method.limitations: Static source and DATA preflight only; no constructors, producer/owner/checker CLI, compiler, tests, archive/dependency program or old Git program executed. This is not an exhaustive whole-program reachability proof; saved frame/npm profile obligations remain separately scoped.
